name: The MasterMind 3
summary: The MasterMind 3 is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses a combination of technical indicators to identify trend direction and enter trades on momentum shifts. It employs multiple timeframe confluence and indicator agreement to generate entry signals, with built-in risk management through stop loss and take profit levels. The EA aims to capture trending moves by entering when multiple momentum indicators align in the same direction.
summary_zh: The MasterMind 3是一个基于动量的专家顾问，使用多种技术指标的组合来识别趋势方向并在动量转换时入场交易。它采用多周期一致性和指标共振来生成入场信号，并通过止损和止盈水平进行内置风险管理。该EA旨在通过多个动量指标同向排列时入场来捕捉趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多指标动量共振策略，通过多个技术指标同时确认方向来产生交易信号。入场条件要求多个动量指标（如RSI、MACD、随机指标等）在同一方向上达成一致，确保较高的入场胜率。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、反向信号出现以及尾随止损等多种方式。仓位管理基于账户余额的百分比计算，支持固定手数和动态手数两种模式。资金管理方面设有最大回撤限制和单日最大亏损限制，以防止极端行情下的过度损失。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-indicator momentum confluence strategy, generating trade signals when multiple technical indicators confirm the same direction simultaneously. Entry conditions require agreement across several momentum indicators (such as RSI, MACD, Stochastic, etc.) to ensure higher entry accuracy. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit, reverse signal detection, and trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing is calculated as a percentage of account balance, supporting both fixed lot and dynamic lot sizing modes. Money management incorporates maximum drawdown limits and daily loss caps to prevent excessive losses during extreme market conditions.
pros: 多指标共振确认入场信号，降低了虚假信号的概率
内置多种出场机制，包括尾随止损和反向信号出场，灵活性强
包含点差过滤和最大回撤限制，风险管理较为完善
支持动态仓位计算，可根据账户规模自动调整风险暴露
多周期一致性验证提高了交易信号的可靠性
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence entry confirmation reduces false signal probability
Multiple exit mechanisms including trailing stop and reverse signal exit provide flexibility
Spread filter and maximum drawdown limits contribute to solid risk management
Dynamic position sizing automatically adjusts risk exposure based on account size
Multi-timeframe confluence verification improves signal reliability
cons: 多指标共振可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期最有利的入场点
参数较多，优化空间大但存在过拟合风险
在震荡市中动量指标容易产生错误信号，缺乏震荡市过滤机制
固定止盈止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在不同行情下适应性不足
回测结果可能因指标滞后性而与实盘表现存在较大差异
cons_en: Multi-indicator confluence may cause delayed entry, missing optimal trend initiation points
Many parameters create large optimization space with overfitting risk
Momentum indicators prone to false signals in ranging markets, lacking range filter mechanism
Fixed stop loss/take profit doesn't adapt to changing market volatility
Backtest results may differ significantly from live performance due to indicator lag
improvements: 增加市场状态识别机制，在震荡行情中减少或暂停交易
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整出场水平
添加交易时间过滤，避开低流动性时段和重大新闻发布时间
improvements_en: Add market regime detection to reduce or pause trading during ranging conditions
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit that adapts to market volatility
Add trading session filter to avoid low liquidity periods and major news releases

risk_points: 多指标策略在震荡市中可能连续止损
固定止损未考虑波动率，在剧烈行情中可能被扫损后价格反转
缺乏对冲机制，单方向持仓在极端行情下风险较大
risk_points_en: Multi-indicator strategy may suffer consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss without volatility consideration may get stopped out before price reversal
No hedging mechanism, directional positions carry significant risk during extreme market moves

It employs multiple timeframe confluence and indicator agreement to generate entry signals, with built-in risk management through stop loss and take profit levels. The EA aims to capture trending moves by entering when multiple momentum indicators align in the same direction.
